Statistics of [[Süper Lig|Turkish First Football League]] in the 1996/1997 season.

==Overview==
It was contested by 18 teams, and [[Galatasaray S.K. (football team)|Galatasaray S.K.]] won the championship. [[Sarıyer G.K.]], [[Denizlispor]] and [[Zeytinburnuspor]] relegated to Second League.
